race.comment: YEAH BUDDY (1) consistent gelding expected to get off the mark today at start eleven. Finished runner-up again after covering ground when a tidy second over 1100m at Scone. Blinkers and tongue-tie come off and will appreciate the 3kg claim. MONGOLIAN MASTER (2) lightly raced gelding heading in the right direction. Cruised across from the sticky draw to grip on and finish second over 1200m at this track after leading for much of the way. Apprentice sticks and has genuine winning claims. MR HUGO (9) has been kept safe in betting at both starts and looking for a firmer track. From an in-form yard and can turn it around today. CRIME OF PASSION (3) finished third last start over 1100m at Pakenham Synthetic, 3.5 lengths from the winner. In the mix.
